Original assets and frame factories; typed exact-target guards where proven, variable target guard otherwise. Camera aspect correction for widescreen is an accepted host presentation policy, not original widescreen support.

groups.difference_or_boundary: Four original atlas roles; original width-dependent entrance delay and signed16 scroll/baselines preserved. No Credits decoder/voice.

groups.difference_or_boundary: Codec/device operations delegated; sound startup flags0402 are bounded host defaults; partial release relies on nonthrowing correct foreign ABI.

groups.area: Borrowed input, original device services and pointer composition
groups.difference_or_boundary: Normal app borrows startup keyboard/mouse; engine polling and reacquisition delegated. Separate preview owners stay diagnostic. Normal joystick list proven empty, no successful synthetic enumeration.

Native locks/containers/CRT paths; optional control wrapper absent on normal cold path, not successful replacement. Actual scene/camera sound-world absent until real game owner; firewall modification rejects.

rw_data codecs/registry/file/search/write behavior remains original DLL; caches reconstruct client policy with native RAII. Missing click buffer tolerated, missing required models fail. Native diagnostics replace dbgPrintf.

Exact-target and export checks; sound portal self-on-stack slot04 target not proven and only relevant to deferred live sound-world. Do not count engine implementations or optional control service as recovered.

Native ownership/registration/observer pointers replace original object/vtable ABI; ordinary queue/focus lifecycle recovered. Runtime diagnostics are not original labels. Exception aggregation intentionally improves acquired-prefix safety.

groups.area: Actual widget visuals and native parts
groups.difference_or_boundary: Adapters instantiate recovered factory/control/event logic and engine visuals; native type layout/refcount/allocator identity differs.

groups.area: Options pages and binding list composition
groups.difference_or_boundary: Front-end family6 accepted; in-game family2 deferred. Gamma requires fullscreen initialization flag, so disabled in windowed launch. Writer failures retain original ignored-return semantics.

groups.area: Real profile CRUD/edit/list and native filesystem
groups.difference_or_boundary: Isolated physical directory operations with component/reparse guards and no cwd changes; real profile/options persistence, not gameplay-save loading. Wide-mode editing unavailable.

groups.area: Profile-filtered movie list and silent preview
groups.difference_or_boundary: Actual catalog/unlocks/movies; unopened preview safe guard differs from original undefined dimension consumption. Missing Africa/Czech development remnants expected. Empty filename fallback to Credits preserved.

Bounded team accepted; full loadout flow completely untested until accessible. Real item/human stock and validated owned handoff; game receiver and gameplay-save loading explicitly unavailable/Phase2. No world-entry success proxy.

groups.area: Real DirectPlay discovery and explicit session boundary
groups.difference_or_boundary: DirectPlay OS/COM enumerate/cancel/close used; owned callback data queued. GameSpy unavailable; join/host return explicit unavailable, never accepted, result0 unreachable as transport result on that production path. Ready-server-dependent UI/transport deferred to Phase3; status9 game entry Phase2.

groups.area: Separate preview/probe targets and diagnostic services
groups.difference_or_boundary: Independent preview/probe roots; not normal application services. Native diagnostic routing/default availability does not establish live menu delivery.
